That is, whether leader or not, every unit can read its own unit databag as well as every other unit's unit databag as well as the application databag.
For production you should configure your Vault securely, following recommendations in the upstream Vault documentation.
The service account used to generate the access token must have been configured with a cluster role binding to allow the necessary access privileges.
Each unit involved in a relation gets a local copy of all the databags for that relation.

In Juju, a secret is a sensitive bit of information (e.g., account credential, password, certificate, SSH key, API key, encryption key, etc.) that a charm needs to know.
